About this skills log

During this module, I completed independent assessments and worked with classmates in a structured group debate. The experiences below demonstrate how I developed communication, teamwork, independent learning, commitment to deadlines, and critical thinking. Each section includes evidence from my participation.

Five employability skills

Skill 1

Collaborative Working

During the group debate, I worked with classmates to prepare arguments, divide responsibilities, and deliver a coordinated presentation. I learned to listen to different viewpoints and support the group’s shared objective.

Evidence: participation in the group debate presentation.
Skill 2

Verbal Communication

Presenting my section of the debate helped me communicate ideas clearly in front of an audience. I practised speaking at an appropriate pace, summarising key points, and contributing to the group conclusion.

Evidence: speaking as part of the group presentation.
Skill 3

Meeting Commitments and Deadlines

I completed the timed module quiz within the required assessment window while balancing university with work and personal responsibilities. This demonstrates reliability, preparation, and commitment to completing academic tasks.

Evidence: completed BSM24001 quiz with a final grade of 75%.
Skill 4

Independent Learning

I reviewed module content independently before completing the quiz. The result showed that personal preparation and self-directed study helped me understand the subject and apply what I had learned.

Evidence: independent preparation contributed to a 75% result.
Skill 5

Critical Thinking and Problem Solving

The debate required me to examine the ethical impact of artificial intelligence on employment. I compared opposing arguments, considered consequences for workers and businesses, and helped produce a balanced conclusion.

Evidence: analysing and presenting arguments during the debate.

Reflective Summary — 150 words

During this module, I have developed several employability skills that will help me in both my studies and my future career. At the beginning, I was not confident speaking in English in front of other people, but completing the Everlast presentation, the Show and Tell activity and the group debate helped me improve my confidence and communication skills. Creating this webpage also helped me organise my achievements and reflect on the progress I have made throughout the course. I have improved my teamwork, digital skills and time management by completing different tasks and meeting deadlines. These experiences have prepared me for future university assignments and will also help me manage my own construction business more professionally. Overall, this module has given me greater confidence and has shown me the importance of continuous learning and personal development.
